description: Operation Audit Base rule set: 16-column contract / quarterly rotation / archive retention / bilingual daily & weekly reports / ingest markers / anomaly thresholds / storage path (all computable, no hardcoding)

storage.note: empty base_dir = use the LOCALAPPDATA default; --base-dir overrides; during development you may fall back to the in-package assets/; use the migrate subcommand to move legacy data (copy, source kept)

incomplete.desc: missing required fields -> mark incomplete, original event NOT written, log a WARN

unverified_source.desc: unrecognized source -> mark unverified_source, log a WARN, original event still written

conflict.desc: DENY but an ALLOW for the same actor+target exists within the window -> mark conflict, log a CRIT, original event still written

alerts.redaction: evidence_hash fingerprint only; zero sensitive values on disk

undo.verify: compare sha256 in manifest on restore

redaction_policy: evidence_hash stores fingerprints only (first 16 chars of SHA256); responses containing sensitive fields record field names only; verbatim exception quotes go to the note column only
